[overview] White Mountain (6,378 ft) sits in the remote southern interior of Olympic National Park, 0.95 mi southwest of its higher neighbor Mount La Crosse (6,417 ft), with an unnamed glacier occupying the north cirque between the two summits.
[hazards] Remnant/unnamed glacier and permanent snowfield in the north cirque between White Mountain and Mount La Crosse - crevasse and steep-snow hazard in that terrain, especially early season.
[obj_haz] snow patches.
[watch_out] Snow can persist on north-facing slopes and the La Crosse-White Mountain cirque into July.
